handoff: Approve: review #1's blocking finding is fixed (a real-git integration test proves the per-pair-of-heads overlap cache and the observe/view wiring); all five criteria traced to tests; one minor note left (item's since resets every tick).

findings.title: Overlap item's `since` is the current tick, so its age resets every tick (carried from review #1)
findings.detail:
`since: iso(facts.now)` makes the item look new on every render and sort as the newest Check item for as long as the overlap lasts.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Optional: keep a first-seen time in the overlap.json pair entry and use it as `since`.
